notes: Characterization centers on the SCLK/data timing (SDR vs DDR, DQS alignment), the dummy-cycle latency margin at frequency, multi-IO read integrity, program/erase timing, and SFDP fidelity.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SCLK timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify SCLK frequency range, setup/hold, and SDR/DDR data-valid windows.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Dummy-cycle sweep
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Find the minimum dummy cycles per read mode at each frequency without read corruption.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: DQS alignment (octal DDR)
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify DQS-to-data edge alignment and the controller's source-synchronous capture.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Program/erase timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure WIP busy time for page program, sector/block/chip erase.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SFDP decode
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm SFDP tables match device behavior (read modes, dummy cycles, address bytes).
